entities.summary: Joseph Andrew Wieland is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Los Angeles Dodgers, and Seattle Mariners. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yokohama DeNA BayStars, and in the KBO League the Kia Tigers.
